IT Security Policy
Employees must protect company accounts and devices.
Strong passwords should be used and credentials must not be shared with other people.
Employees should report suspicious emails, unexpected login requests, or possible security incidents to the IT team.
Company systems should be used for authorized business activities.
Confidential company information must not be disclosed to unauthorized parties.

Remote Work Policy
Employees approved for remote work are responsible for maintaining a suitable and secure work environment.
Company devices should be protected from unauthorized access.
Employees should use approved company systems when accessing internal information remotely.
Remote workers should report equipment problems or security concerns to IT.
Normal working hours and communication expectations remain applicable during remote work.

Attendance Policy
Employees are expected to arrive on time and maintain regular attendance.
If an employee cannot attend work, they should notify their manager as early as possible.
Repeated attendance issues may require a discussion with the employee and manager.
Managers are responsible for maintaining accurate attendance records.
Exceptions may be considered when supported by applicable company policy.
